clips.title: The story
paras: Alliance paladins face a trial of courage and duty in the Tome of Valor. Mentors in Stormwind and Ironforge ask them to prove they will protect the innocent as well as fight with skill.

Young paladins in Stormwind and Ironforge must prove their resolve. In the Cathedral of Light and the Hall of Mysteries, instructors test whether each initiate can face terrible danger without faltering. The trial measures more than armor or skill with a weapon. Paladins must also show they will stay beside those who cannot defend themselves, whether the threat comes from dragons or demons.

A holy warrior needs bravery as much as a weapon and shield. The trial teaches paladins that strength means little without a firm vow to shelter the helpless. When danger threatens the Alliance, its defenders must hold their ground and protect those in their care.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It has been proven that the Light is with you, friend, but as times grow more dangerous, it becomes important to know what strength lies beneath the flesh. When demons, dragons, or any other evil set foot in your lands, your mettle will be tested. Will you be strong enough?

Bravery, regardless of the situation, is as much a part of paladinhood as the Light, your armor, and your weapon. Protecting the weak, and not losing faith are two more lessons you must master while you study in the Cathedral of Light.
